deployments_detail.use: Strategic partnership with Mistral AI moving from pilots to enterprise-wide genAI deployment across engineering, embedded/in-car experiences and operations; Innovation Lab + Transformation Academy (own press release)
Mistral AI partnership: AI in vehicle engineering, fleet data analysis, in-car assistant, manufacturing optimization
Microsoft + NVIDIA collaboration for predictive manufacturing in factories
In-car generative-AI assistant acting as a real-time, voice-enabled user manual so drivers can ask about vehicle features and troubleshooting, built on Mistral AI LLMs [Mistral AI]
Bill-of-Materials intelligence chatbot that analyzes component databases to help engineers optimize part selection and maximize part reuse during vehicle development [Mistral AI]
Automated analysis of development-fleet and customer-survey data to identify quality trends and corrective actions [Mistral AI]
Wayve end-to-end AI Driver integrated into the STLA AutoDrive platform for hands-free, door-to-door supervised (Level 2++) automated driving, targeting North America launch in 2028 [Wayve]
Level 4 autonomous robotaxis built on Stellantis L4-Ready platforms using Wayve's end-to-end AI driving software, deployed via the Uber network across Europe and North America [Wayve, Uber]

SoundHound Chat AI Automotive generative-AI voice assistant live in production in Jeep vehicles across European markets, enabling conversational trip planning, vehicle-manual help and contextual follow-ups [SoundHound AI]

DS Automobiles integrated ChatGPT into the IRIS in-car voice assistant (DS3, DS4, DS7, DS9), letting drivers ask open-ended questions - billed as a European automaker first [OpenAI (ChatGPT / GPT-3.5), SoundHound]

Manufacturing anomaly detection using edge-computing GenAI models to assess real-time production errors on assembly lines (e.g. Mulhouse plant) and enable corrective action before parts are released [Mistral AI]

AI-driven manufacturing using NVIDIA digital twins and advanced simulation for closed-loop production optimization, predictive maintenance and throughput, piloting across North American assembly and engine plants [Accenture, NVIDIA (Omniverse / digital twins)]
Club Stellantis virtual assistant, an employee-facing chatbot supporting company-vehicle purchases with multilingual query handling, live in France with planned European expansion [Mistral AI]

Expanded collaboration with Applied Intuition to develop the STLA Brain vehicle software platform and STLA SmartCockpit using Applied Intuition's Vehicle OS, Cabin Intelligence and autonomy/simulation stack [Applied Intuition, Qualcomm (Snapdragon Digital Chassis)]
